title: Request for Proposal (RFP): Supply of Laptops
intro: Toynbee Hall is seeking proposals from vendors for the supply of laptops.

sections.text: Toynbee Hall is seeking proposals from vendors for the supply of laptops
These laptops are part of an overall refresh of our tech infrastructure to ensure its fit for purpose.

All proposals must be received by 15 December 2023 and we will be ready to purchase the product by January 2024 – so delivery timeline must allow for setup and handover to end users by February 2024 at the latest.
Find out more about the scope of work and specifications of laptops required.
